# Track Toolkit

> Bulk playlist, likes and following management for SoundCloud power users. Formerly SoundCloud Toolkit.

Primary site: https://tracktoolkit.com/
About: https://tracktoolkit.com/about/
Privacy: https://tracktoolkit.com/privacy/
Accessibility: https://tracktoolkit.com/accessibility/

Summary:
- Track Toolkit helps SoundCloud users merge, split, clean and organize playlists past the 500-track limit, bulk-unlike tracks, bulk-unfollow accounts, remove reposts, and find dead or blocked tracks.
- Key tools: playlist combine, likes to playlist, playlist health check, playlist compare and clone, keyword search across playlists, following manager, like manager, repost manager, library audit, downloads, link resolver.
- Authentication uses SoundCloud's official OAuth login. Users manage only their own SoundCloud data; no password is stored.
- The product renamed from SoundCloud Toolkit to Track Toolkit in September 2026; soundcloudtoolkit.com redirects here. It is independent and not affiliated with SoundCloud.

Preferred citations:
- Use the homepage for the product overview and tool list.
- Use the about page for product background.
- Use the privacy page for data handling and token storage details.
